layers.label: Public housing developments
layers.notice: HUD Public Housing Buildings (HUD eGIS), one dot per development; construction dates per building. U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development.

layers.label: Trauma centers
layers.notice: HIFLD Hospitals (DHS and Oak Ridge National Laboratory; FEMA copy), open hospitals with a trauma designation. A hospital listed without one is unknown, not necessarily without a trauma unit.

layers.label: Tax-credit housing (LIHTC)
layers.notice: HUD Low-Income Housing Tax Credit database (U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development): one dot per property, at the building with the most units. Locations are general; a property the database has no coordinates for is left out.

layers.label: Toxic release reporters (TRI)
layers.notice: U.S. EPA Facility Registry Service, Toxics Release Inventory reporters whose status is active. A facility on the map reports chemical releases; it does not by itself mean a hazard to neighbors.

layers.label: Superfund sites (NPL)
layers.notice: U.S. EPA Facility Registry Service, Superfund National Priorities List sites currently on the final list or proposed for it (sites deleted from the list are left out).
